policy: Source integrations are shared pointers and wrappers. Do not vendor upstream source trees or duplicate full skill bodies into AI client roots.

sources.label: Lightpanda
sources.purpose: AI-controlled browser runtime for scraping, JavaScript-rendered page loading, markdown extraction, semantic DOM extraction, form workflows, and CDP automation when graphical rendering is not required.
sources.notes: Docker-backed on Windows. Use native web search for search-engine queries; use Lightpanda for page retrieval, extraction, and CDP workflows.

sources.label: Context Mode
sources.purpose: Context-window protection, long-output routing, and indexed session continuity.
sources.notes: Context Mode is scratch/context infrastructure. Do not store durable facts here when MemPalace is available.

sources.label: MemPalace
sources.purpose: Authoritative shared memory and prior-decision lookup across local AI clients.
sources.notes: Never store secrets, raw logs, temporary scratch notes, or unverified guesses in durable memory.

sources.label: Web search
sources.purpose: Fresh web research through the host AI's native web/search tools when available.
fallbacks: lightpanda-fetch for page retrieval and extraction
tavily-web skill when the user supplies a Tavily key
browser plugin or host browser automation when graphical rendering is required
sources.notes: This repo does not proxy or scrape search engines by default. Keep web search credentials out of repo config.

sources.label: GBrain
sources.purpose: Brain-first retrieval, structured local lookup, explicit memory mirror, and durable agent context.
sources.notes: GBrain mirrors explicit saved memories and offers structured lookup. MemPalace remains the authoritative durable memory store.

sources.label: GSkills / GStack
sources.purpose: Read-only engineering process skills and GStack/GBrain skill sources indexed by skill-router.
sources.notes: Load namespaced skills such as gstack-review, gstack-qa, gstack-cso, and gstack-browse on demand. Do not copy the full GStack or GBrain skill trees into AI roots.
